title: EXTEND_FOOTPRINT_TTL from a muxed source with a text memo
pattern: Core refuses a memo or muxed source only on InvokeHostFunction (TransactionFrame::validateSorobanMemo); on TTL and restore operations both are valid. The JS SDK builder refuses them, so this was built by hand. wallet-backend#753 halted on this shape.

hazards.placement: muxed Transaction.sourceAccount and MEMO_TEXT on ExtendFootprintTTL
P28 variant, the newest protocol a pre-fix wallet-backend (#753 at f8e5786d) ingests

facts.says: The source is alice muxed with ID 753.
